items.stem: Why should an analyst combine observation with interviews rather than relying on interviews alone?

options.text: What people say they do often differs from what they actually do
options.rationale: Correct: observation surfaces real behaviour and undocumented workarounds.
Interviews are valuable; observation complements them.

options.text: Observation removes the need to confirm requirements
options.rationale: Confirmation is still required regardless of technique.

options.text: Interviews cannot capture any real requirements
options.rationale: They capture many; they just miss unspoken behaviour.

items.explanation: Correct: observation surfaces real behaviour and undocumented workarounds.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which actions help manage conflicting requirements from different stakeholders? (Select TWO)

options.text: Making the conflict explicit and tracing each need to its source
options.rationale: Correct: surfacing and sourcing the conflict enables a reasoned resolution.

options.text: Facilitating a decision based on business value and priority
options.rationale: Correct: prioritisation by value resolves conflicts defensibly.

options.text: Silently choosing the requirement from the most senior person
options.rationale: Seniority alone is not a sound basis for a requirements decision.

options.text: Recording both contradictory requirements without resolving them
options.rationale: Unresolved contradictions will cause defects downstream.

items.explanation: Correct: surfacing and sourcing the conflict enables a reasoned resolution.

items.stem: A stakeholder nods through an entire workshop and asks nothing. What is the safest interpretation?

options.text: Silence does not confirm understanding or agreement
options.rationale: Correct: active confirmation is needed; silence is ambiguous.
Silence is not evidence of agreement.
Lack of questions does not mean lack of needs.

options.text: The session can be closed with no follow-up
options.rationale: Confirmation should still be sought explicitly.

items.explanation: Correct: active confirmation is needed; silence is ambiguous.
